page: Amazon Web Services r9gd.large is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by AWS Graviton ARM64 processors. It features 2 dedicated physical cores running at 3.3 GHz with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, providing 2 vCPUs. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance type includes 118 GB of local NVMe SSD instance store volumes, offering high-speed local storage directly attached to the hypervisor. It operates on the AWS Nitro hypervisor and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included.

The arm64 architecture and dedicated core allocation deliver predictable performance and high resource density, making the instance a cost-efficient choice for memory-bound workloads that benefit from local scratch storage. It is suitable for small-scale databases, in-memory caching, local data processing, and distributed systems requiring high memory-per-core ratios without the overhead of simultaneous multithreading.
